title: LIVE_DERIVATION_RE's \bmain\b matches the 'main' inside 'main.ts', so any `git grep PATTERN main.ts` falsely counts as a live-derivation token
description:
In src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts:162, LIVE_DERIVATION_RE is:

    /git\s+show\s+main:|git\s+diff\s+main\b|git\s+grep\b[^\n]*\bmain\b/

The third alternative requires only a `git grep` plus the word `main` somewhere later on the same line. Because `.` is a non-word character, `\bmain\b` matches the `main` inside the FILENAME `main.ts`. So an oracle such as `test $(git grep -c PATTERN main.ts) -eq 3` is treated as live-derived against the main BRANCH when it is nothing of the sort, and every integer comparand in the command is excused. That is a false negative: the frozen 3 rots silently, which is precisely what the frozen-comparand rule exists to prevent.

The existing test at test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts:200-203 pins the adjacent case (`mainbranch:file.ts` correctly does NOT match, since `b` is a word character) while this closely-related case is broken. So the rule has a test asserting the boundary works, next to an untested input where it does not.

DISTINCT FROM CAM-383. CAM-383 is about WHICH comparands a derivation token excuses (whole-command vs per-comparand scoping). This is about WHAT QUALIFIES as a derivation token in the first place. Fixing one does not fix the other: per-comparand scoping still excuses the comparand sitting in the same clause as a bogus `main.ts` token.

Likely direction: require the `main` token to appear in a git-ref position (followed by `:` or a whitespace/end boundary that is not a filename extension), rather than as a bare word anywhere on the line. Needs a flagged-forms test per accepted ref shape and a passing-case test per rejected filename shape.

Needs rebuild: prd-oracle-lint.ts is sidecar-executed at plan time (plan-runner.ts:804).

spec.scope: Fix two false-verdict defects in the frozen-integer-comparand oracle-lint rule in src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts (sidecar-executed at plan time via plan-runner.ts:804), and add one patterns.md author note. UMBRELLA: subsumes CAM-389; close CAM-389 at ship. Defect A (CAM-386): LIVE_DERIVATION_RE (line 171) third+second alternatives use a bare word boundary after 'main', so 'main' inside a FILENAME like main.ts or src/main.rs is read as a git-ref token, falsely excusing every frozen integer comparand in that clause (a false NEGATIVE: the rule that exists to catch rotting literals goes silent). Defect B (CAM-389): extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (lines 300-316) splices a preserved $(...) span back verbatim without recursively stripping quotes inside it, so inert single-quoted comparison data nested in a double-quoted command substitution is still scanned, producing a false POSITIVE. Doc note (penned suggestion 65d7a3ad6cfc): per-clause scoping legitimately flags the two-clause exit-code idiom, which is intended but an author footgun; add a patterns.md note. Surgical: touch only prd-oracle-lint.ts, its test, the oracle-lint fixture, and patterns.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Defect A red-on-main measurement (verified this cycle on unmodified main): frozen-comparand wrongly EXCUSES an oracle whose only derivation-shaped token is 'main' inside the filename 'main.ts' (and 'src/main.rs'); after the fix the rule FLAGS both, because a filename 'main' is not a git ref. A test asserts frozen-comparand returns non-null for a 'git grep -c PATTERN main.ts' oracle whose count is compared to a literal, and this test is red against unmodified main and green after the fix.

Defect A non-regression: frozen-comparand still returns null (excused) for every genuine derivation ref shape: a 'git show main:PATH' read, a bare 'git grep PATTERN main' tree grep, a 'git grep PATTERN main:src/f.ts' ref, and a 'git diff main -- f.ts' diff, each piped to a counter compared numerically. A flagged-forms and a rejected-forms test row exists per accepted ref shape and per rejected filename shape.

Defect B red-on-main measurement (verified this cycle on unmodified main): frozen-comparand wrongly FLAGS a double-quoted command substitution whose only numeric comparison is inert single-quoted data (the shape echo of a double-quoted dollar-paren grep whose single-quoted pattern contains a numeric equality); after the fix the rule returns null. A test asserts frozen-comparand returns null for that shape, red against unmodified main and green after fix.

Defect B non-regression: frozen-comparand still FLAGS a genuine wc-l pipeline whose count is compared to a bare literal integer, still EXCUSES a real 'git show main:PATH' derivation nested in a command substitution, and the fix preserves derivation tokens inside $(...) (they are unquoted so recursion leaves them intact). Recursion terminates (each level operates on a strictly smaller inner substring).

The oracle-lint fixture test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt gains rows covering both defects (the main.ts filename false-negative and the inert-nested-data false-positive), consumed by the existing table-driven matrix test so they are CI-gated, and the fixture-shape guard still passes.

patterns.md gains a note for oracle authors (near the frozen-comparand guidance at patterns.md:903) that the two-clause exit-code idiom (a 'git diff main --quiet' check whose exit code is tested in a following clause) is flagged by design because the derivation token and the comparand sit in different clauses; authors must keep them in one clause or re-derive in the same clause. Cross-reference by absolute line number.
bun run typecheck passes and the full bun test suite is green (0 fail); the changed functions stay under the per-function line ceiling enforced by noExcessiveLinesPerFunction.
gotchas: MANDATORY oracle-authoring discipline on THIS surface (the dominant self-inflicted failure here): every acceptance oracle string is itself scanned by the rule being modified. Single-quote comparison-shaped case strings so quote-stripping treats them as data, avoid possessive apostrophes entirely, and run every intended oracle through the exported RULES array (import RULES, call rule.test on each) to confirm zero findings BEFORE finalizing. The orchestrator already swept the four behavioral criteria above lint-clean this cycle.

NEVER let 'bun test <file>' be a behavior criterion's sole oracle: a story that ADDS tests can never make its own test file red on unmodified main. Author the behavioral oracle as an inline probe that imports RULES and asserts the POST-FIX verdict, so it exits red on main (bug present) and green after the fix. The orchestrator measured all four verdicts red/green on main already.

CAM-386 exact fix (measured, 8-case matrix 0-wrong on unmodified main): in LIVE_DERIVATION_RE (line 171) replace the bare 'main' word-boundary in BOTH the 'git diff main' and 'git grep ... main' alternatives with a negative-lookahead that rejects a following word char, dot, slash, or hyphen, so 'main' must be at a ref boundary (colon, whitespace, or end) and not a filename stem. The 'git show main:' first alternative already uses an explicit colon and is fine. The adjacent existing boundary test (mainbranch: does not match) must still pass.

CAM-389 exact fix (measured false-positive on unmodified main): inside extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (lines 300-316) recurse stripQuotedSpans over the preserved $(...) inner content instead of splicing it verbatim, so nested quoted data is stripped while the unquoted command structure (including derivation refs) survives. This creates mutual recursion with stripQuotedSpans (line 378 caller); it terminates because the inner slice is strictly shorter. Residual accepted limit: 2+level nested double-quoted command substitutions are not fully stripped (astronomically rare in oracle criteria); note as a limit, not a bug.

Neither src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts (663 lines) nor its test (684) is in scripts/file-size-budget.json, so no _ref bump is needed; but noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (a per-function ceiling, source doc lines 271-272/626-627) DOES apply, so keep the touched functions tight.

Fold penned suggestion 65d7a3ad6cfc (the two-clause exit-code footgun) as the patterns.md note criterion above; dismiss the pen entry after ship. Ship auto-closes only the plan_issue (CAM-386); close CAM-389 by hand as subsumed after the CLEAN review.

macOS host: no `timeout`, foreground `sleep` is harness-blocked; write probe payloads to /tmp (never under .claude/, which trips the plan preflight clean-tree guard) using a heredoc + String.raw; print a row COUNT so vacuity is visible.
domainTerms: LIVE_DERIVATION_RE (prd-oracle-lint.ts:171): regex deciding whether a clause carries a live git-ref re-derivation token that excuses a frozen integer comparand.
INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE (line 163): 8-operator (-eq/-ne/-gt/-lt/-ge/-le/==/!=) frozen-literal matcher with a start-or-non-word-non-hyphen left anchor.
hasFrozenIntegerComparand (425-431): strips quotes, splits on &&/||/;/newline, flags a clause matching INTEGER_COMPARAND_RE without LIVE_DERIVATION_RE in that SAME clause.
extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (300-316): preserves top-level $(...) spans verbatim so derivation refs inside a command substitution survive quote-stripping; the CAM-389 fix site.
stripQuotedSpans (361-390): removes quoted data before clause splitting; recurses on sh -c wrappers and calls extractCommandSubstitutionSpans on double-quoted spans.
RULES (612-617): exported OracleLintRule[] ({name, test(command)->RuleFinding|null}); frozen-comparand is the rule under change.
